d: Prominent northern spring constellation shaped like a kite, anchored by brilliant orange giant Arcturus.

hip-69673.x: Brightest star in the northern celestial hemisphere (36.7 ly), an ancient orange giant speeding through the galactic disc.

gaia-1279798794197267072.x: Stunning double star consisting of a bright orange giant and smaller blue-white main-sequence companion.

hip-67927.x: Evolved G-type subgiant star closely neighboring Arcturus in space (~3.3 ly apart).

gaia-1604859511344724864.x: White main-sequence dwarf star marking the western wing tip of the kite asterism.

gaia-1296713990316692096.x: Yellow giant star situated at the northern crown of the Herdsman.
